title: UK racing site evidence scoring review

observed_patterns: flags such as Horse In Focus / Warning Horse / Hot Races
ratings based on merit and distance beaten

findings.finding: Split evidence into clear buckets, not one mystery score
findings.signal75_action: Keep main Signal 75 score, but show and store separate evidence groups: Find, Confirm, Protect, Learn.

findings.finding: Tipster support should count source quality and independence
findings.signal75_action: Give more value to named trusted experts and independent sources; reduce duplicated/soft aggregator consensus.

findings.finding: Ratings/form should be checked against race conditions
findings.signal75_action: Course, distance, going, surface, class and field size should become one condition-confidence layer, not four confusing separate warnings.

findings.finding: Distance beaten is valuable collateral form
findings.signal75_action: Use winning margins and beaten distances to strengthen horses to follow and caution horses.

findings.finding: Post-race comments should explain why, not just what happened
findings.signal75_action: Store whether a horse won easily, was unlucky, weakened, stayed on, failed to respond, or was heavily beaten.

findings.finding: Market evidence is a confirmation layer, not a last-minute switch
findings.signal75_action: Track market confidence/drift as learning and warning evidence, but do not confuse users by changing public picks near the off.

findings.finding: The best sites separate picks, watchlists, and horses to follow
findings.signal75_action: Keep official proof clean, but make watchlist/follow horses clearer as learning evidence, not betting advice.
Translate technical labels into plain English: Find = our score found it; Confirm = outside support; Protect = risks; Learn = what happened after.

proposed_end_july_strategy.name: Find
proposed_end_july_strategy.purpose: Signal 75 ranks every runner using price/value, race fit, field size, market data, history and form.

proposed_end_july_strategy.name: Confirm
proposed_end_july_strategy.purpose: Trusted tipsters, named experts and market support validate or challenge the Signal 75 view.

proposed_end_july_strategy.name: Protect
proposed_end_july_strategy.purpose: Remove or downgrade risky runners: bad recent form, false consensus, weak conditions, too many same-race/same-course picks, chaotic fields.

proposed_end_july_strategy.name: Learn
proposed_end_july_strategy.purpose: After racing, store winners, beaten distances, rival evidence, horses to follow, caution horses and repeat patterns.

proposed_end_july_strategy.name: Review
proposed_end_july_strategy.purpose: At end of July, only promote rules that repeatedly improved results without harming proof clarity.
